The speaker has authority or credibility to lead discussions on cybersecurity.
The audience values civic participation in national security matters.
Adversaries respond to credible threats of retaliation.
Incentivizing corporate behavior is a feasible approach to improving cybersecurity.
Audiences expect continuity and regular updates from media programs.
Twitter is an appropriate platform for public discourse on technical policy topics.
Pioneering work in cybersecurity is both recognized and valued by the audience.
Trust in producers like Tom Ascot contributes to the legitimacy of the broadcast.
